TWO_NULL DRIVERS PRECEDED THIS ONE, AND.the_cause: `MfPlans::seal` is handed the body's OWN module. Its callee DECLARATIONS get their signature at CRATE ASSEMBLY, not per body, so there is no callee return type in it to read — by position or by id. The producer records it in the LEDGER instead: `CalleeRef::ret_ty`, 'the RESULT type this crate's call sites actually bind from this callee', observed AT THE SITE and deliberately not re-derived from the callee's rustc signature — which is the independence the predicted side needs, because the emitter types its locals from that signature and `observe` reads the finished `local_decls`.
TWO_NULL DRIVERS PRECEDED THIS ONE, AND.the_pin: `unit_chain_tests::test_the_callee_result_type_comes_from_the_PRODUCER_LEDGER` — the test that would have said so in one second: it fixes a ledger, checks the lookup against an unknown entry, a poisoned entry and two disagreeing entries, and runs the whole grammar through it.
